value.hook: Read before sending a request, assigning a verdict seat, or chasing a quiet coder
value.title: Routing work through PEC verbs

sections.name: body
sections.value:
- Reviewer verdicts: assign reviewer/<pr> first, then send role:reviewer/<pr> --limit <dur>. Security and performance are one-holder roles with two holders, so neither role:X nor role:X/<pr> resolves (F62); send to the seat until plan 212 fixes it.
- A busy Copilot seat (300k+ context, long turns) gets normal sends hours late and out of order, while --fyi rides along promptly (F69). Send urgent answers to busy coders as --fyi. Send to IDLE seats normally, because an FYI won't wake them.
- s12 limits work: no answer means a check-in, then the PA. But a plain pij send reply doesn't mark a request answered (F68). Reply with --in-reply-to <request id> and update the card (pij report now).
- Holdings don't end at merge (F70). After each merge, release coder/<plan> and reviewer/<pr> until plan 212 makes pij delivered do it.
- lineage add is prime-only. Prepare a script of commands from the LOG and give it to the prime.
- When a seat says it's waiting for your answer, check its queue lag before resending. Five resends didn't help warbler; compaction did.
